summary: The changed files are within scope, and compileall passed. The tests could not run: this read-only sandbox has no writable temporary directory. Static review found two malformed-result cases that still need fixes.

findings.evidence: final = result.get("status", "error") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
findings.problem: A result.json object with no status resolves to error and is written to job.json. The handoff permits only an actual known terminal status; other results must resolve to crashed.
findings.suggestion: Use result.get("status") without an error default, so the existing validation resolves a missing status to crashed. Add a test for {}.

findings.evidence: The malformed-status branch calls job_result(args.job_id). An in-memory reproduction with job.json status ["done"] and no result raised RuntimeError: Job bad-job has no result yet. job_result also rejects a non-object result at jobstore.py:394.
findings.problem: wait still fails to return a job result when the job status is malformed and the result is absent, or when refresh marks a non-object result as crashed.
findings.suggestion: Have wait report the resolved job when result.json cannot supply a valid object, and test those cases.

findings.evidence: jobs.py defines UNFINISHED_STATUSES = {"starting", "running", "canceling"}; jobstore.py:127 defines the same set as UNFINISHED.
findings.problem: Two definitions of the same status group can drift apart.
